verdicts.explanation: Table S5 lists the 'this work' row 'FBN (single-ion)' at 5 × 10−11 S cm−1 with Ea 816 meV, which matches the Fig. 5a label E = 0.82(1) eV for pristine Li2(BN)6C2O4. The room-temperature value has no numeric temperature, so null is correct, and the uncalcined, unsintered pressed pellet (600 MPa) supports null sintering fields.

Table S5 lists the 'this work' row 'lithiated FBN (single-ion)' at 1 × 10−8 S cm−1 with Ea 850 meV, matching the Fig. 5a label E = 0.85(1) eV for Li2(BN)6C2O4 + Li. The text says 2.0 g LBNCO was doped with 200 mg Li by the same ball-milling process, so the synthesis field is correct, and the paper reports no substitutional dopant.
